name: ReviewDB
description: Review other users (Adds a new settings to profiles)
summary: Reviews of users and servers from ReviewDB: read them in profiles, and write, vote on and report them

settings.label: Authorize with ReviewDB
settings.description: Log in to ReviewDB with your Discord account to write, vote on and report reviews

settings.label: Notify reviews
settings.description: Notify about new reviews on startup

settings.label: Show warning
settings.description: Display warning to be respectful at the top of the reviews list

settings.label: ReviewDB login
settings.description: ReviewDB tokens per account, kept in the system keychain

notes: Profiles get a "User Reviews" tab listing a user's reviews (or "No reviews yet" / "User opted out"); clicking one, or "View Reviews" in a user's or a server's menu, opens the reviews window: "<name>'s Reviews" with the count, system messages first, each review's author, badges, date (unless hidden) and text, a menu to view the author's profile, vote, report, block (on your own profile) or delete (your review, your profile, or as a ReviewDB admin), pages of 50, and a box to write or update your review. Writing, voting, reporting and blocking need a ReviewDB login: "Authorize with ReviewDB" (or clicking the box) asks Discord to authorize ReviewDB's app with the identify scope, then trades the code for a ReviewDB token, kept in the system keychain per account. On start, a logged-in account learns about new reviews on its profile (a toast) and ReviewDB's notices (a dialog, marked read). Talks to manti.vendicated.dev, as upstream; the mock answers instead when testing.
gaps: Reviews are plain text: Discord markdown in them isn't rendered.
Your own review is listed with the others rather than pinned above the input, and long reviews aren't shortened to "Read more".
ReviewDB's ban notice offers no Appeal button; its website (from the settings) has the appeal page.
